docs: Angel — `stock_vault`
Two problems, one program.
**1. Raw PreStocks are unusable as a DBC quote asset.** They are Token-2022
mints carrying a non-zero `transferFeeConfig` (50bps today, 100bps from epoch
1039) plus `permanentDelegate`, `pausableConfig`, `scaledUiAmountConfig` and
friends. Meteora's DBC rejects them with `QuoteMintHasNonZeroTransferFee`
(6081), and a token badge does not help — a badge cannot authorise a non-zero
transfer fee. So we mint a 1:1-backed, zero-fee **classic SPL** wrapper, which
is permissionless-supported by DBC. That is what makes a stock-paired bonding
curve possible at all.
**2. Dividends need a vault that cannot be farmed.** `DividendVault` streams
wrapped PreStock to `$AGENT` stakers over a duration rather than dropping
rewards in as a lump sum, so yield is paid for *time held* and a
stake-just-before-the-deposit gets ~nothing.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claim accrued wrapped PreStock (redeemable 1:1 for raw PreStock).

instructions.name: close_agent
docs: Close an agent registration. Creator only; the vault must have no stakers.

instructions.name: deposit_rewards
docs: Route trading fees / arbitrage profits in. Only the agent's creator or
its execution signer may call this. Rewards stream over `duration_slots`.

accounts.name: depositor
docs: The agent's creator or its Clawpump execution signer — the only parties
allowed to fund the dividend stream.

instructions.name: initialize_vault
docs: Create the staking + reward vault for a registered agent.

instructions.name: initialize_wrapper
docs: Create the wrapper mint + reserve for one PreStock mint.

accounts.name: prestock_mint
docs: The raw PreStock mint (Token-2022, transfer-fee bearing).

accounts.name: wrapped_mint
docs: The wrapper mint. Deliberately a **classic SPL Token** mint so that it is
permissionless-supported as a Meteora DBC quote mint — this is the whole
reason the wrapper exists. Its mint authority is the `wrapper_config` PDA,
so only this program can ever create supply.

accounts.name: reserve
docs: PDA token account holding the raw PreStock backing every wrapped token.

instructions.name: log_arb
docs: Log an arbitrage execution. Requires the agent's Pyth `Signal`, whose
oracle fields are copied onto the record — so every logged trade is
Pyth-attested and cannot be fabricated.

accounts.name: signal
docs: The agent's own Pyth signal. Must already have been recorded.

instructions.name: record_signal
docs: Record a Pyth-attested market read (permissionless on-chain read; no API
key or entitlement needed, unlike the gated Hermes equity feeds).

accounts.name: price_update
docs: The Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account. Owner is asserted before we parse it.

instructions.name: register_agent
docs: Register an agent and its revenue split.

accounts.name: agent_token_mint
docs: The `$AGENT` mint. DBC creates this, so it must already exist.

accounts.name: wrapped_mint
docs: The wrapped PreStock the vault pays out (e.g. `wSPACEX`).

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Circuit breaker. PreStocks can pause PreStock transfers via their
Token-2022 `pausableConfig`; this lets us halt cleanly from our side too.

instructions.name: stake
docs: Stake `$AGENT` to start earning wrapped PreStock.

instructions.name: unstake
docs: Withdraw `$AGENT`. Accrued rewards stay claimable.

instructions.name: unwrap
docs: Burn `wPreStock`, receive raw PreStock (less the PreStock transfer fee).

instructions.name: wrap
docs: Deposit raw PreStock, receive `wPreStock` 1:1 on the *received* amount.

accounts.name: prestock_mint
docs: Raw PreStock mint. Pinned by the `wrapper_config` seeds below.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Wrapper is paused

errors.name: InvalidPrestockMint
errors.msg: PreStock mint must be owned by the Token-2022 program

errors.name: InvalidWrappedMint
errors.msg: Wrapped mint must be owned by the classic SPL Token program

errors.name: ReserveWentBackwards
errors.msg: Reserve balance decreased during transfer

errors.name: NothingReceived
errors.msg: Nothing received — the PreStock transfer fee consumed the whole amount

errors.name: InvariantBroken
errors.msg: Invariant violated: wrapped supply != reserve balance

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized

errors.name: AgentMintMismatch
errors.msg: Mint does not match the agent registration

errors.name: VaultNotDrained
errors.msg: Cannot close an agent whose vault still has stakers

errors.name: VaultAgentMismatch
errors.msg: Vault is not linked to this agent

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: Nothing to claim

errors.name: StakeLocked
errors.msg: Stake is still inside the anti-flash-loan hold window

errors.name: InsufficientStake
errors.msg: Insufficient staked balance

errors.name: InvalidDuration
errors.msg: Duration must be greater than zero slots

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: RewardVaultUnderfunded
errors.msg: Reward vault holds less than the vault accounting claims

errors.name: PythAccountOwnerMismatch
errors.msg: Pyth price account is not owned by the Pyth receiver program

errors.name: PythAccountTooSmall
errors.msg: Pyth account is too small to be a PriceUpdateV2

errors.name: PythWrongAccountType
errors.msg: Pyth account is not a PriceUpdateV2

errors.name: PythFeedIdMismatch
errors.msg: Pyth account carries a different feed id than expected

errors.name: StalePrice
errors.msg: Pyth price is older than the caller's staleness policy allows

errors.name: SignalAgentMismatch
errors.msg: Signal belongs to a different agent

errors.name: ExecutionIndexMismatch
errors.msg: Execution index does not match the agent's counter

types.name: Agent
docs: An autonomous trading agent and its revenue split.

fields.name: creator
docs: Deploys the agent, sets fee parameters, receives creator royalties.

fields.name: agent_signer
docs: The Clawpump bot's execution keypair. May route profits into the vault.

fields.name: agent_token_mint
docs: The `$AGENT` mint (created by the Meteora DBC pool). This is the staking token.

fields.name: wrapped_mint
docs: The wrapped PreStock (`wSPACEX` / `wOPENAI`) — the vault's reward token.

fields.name: dynamic_fee_bps
docs: DBC dynamic fee tier, in bps (500 = 5%).

fields.name: total_profits_routed
docs: Historical arbitrage yield routed in, for the UI.

fields.name: execution_count
docs: Number of arb executions logged. Doubles as the PDA index counter.

fields.name: total_profit_logged
docs: Sum of logged execution profit, for the UI.

types.name: ArbExecution
docs: One logged arbitrage execution.
The Pyth fields are **copied from the referenced `Signal`**, not supplied by
the caller. An execution therefore cannot be logged without a real, current,
correctly-identified oracle read behind it — which is what makes the
execution log evidence rather than a claim.

fields.name: amount_in
docs: What the agent committed (quote-asset units).

fields.name: amount_out
docs: What it got back (quote-asset units).

fields.name: profit
docs: `amount_out.saturating_sub(amount_in)` — computed on-chain, not asserted.

types.name: ArbVenue
docs: Where an execution happened. Kept as an enum so the UI can group by venue
and the judge can see the agent really routed through multiple DEXes.

fields.name: amount
docs: Paid in wrapped PreStock — redeemable 1:1 for the raw PreStock.

types.name: DividendVault
docs: Streams `wPreStock` rewards to `$AGENT` stakers.
Rewards are **streamed over a duration** rather than dropped in as a lump
sum. This is the Synthetix `StakingRewards` pattern, and it is the reason
this vault is not flash-loanable: a lump-sum accumulator would hand a
proportional share of a deposit to anyone who staked in the same block,
whereas a stream pays for *time held*. Stake one slot before a deposit and
you earn one slot's worth.
It also gives the doc's "duration-weighted yield" literally, with no
per-user bookkeeping.

fields.name: staking_mint
docs: The `$AGENT` mint users must stake.

fields.name: reward_mint
docs: The reward token — always the wrapped PreStock, never raw PreStock, so the
PreStock transfer fee is paid once on unwrap instead of on every claim.

fields.name: stake_vault
docs: PDA token account holding staked `$AGENT`.

fields.name: reward_vault
docs: PDA token account holding `wPreStock` rewards.

fields.name: agent
docs: Authority allowed to deposit rewards (the agent's creator or signer).

fields.name: acc_reward_per_share
docs: Scaled by `PRECISION`.

fields.name: reward_rate
docs: Rewards per slot currently being streamed.

fields.name: reward_reserve
docs: Deposited rewards not yet streamed out.

fields.name: total_distributed
docs: Lifetime rewards actually streamed into the accumulator.

fields.name: min_hold_slots
docs: Slots a stake must be held before rewards can be claimed.

types.name: MarketRegime
docs: Whether the reference market behind a feed is currently live or frozen.
This is the doc's "Weekend Market Disconnect" thesis encoded on-chain: an
equity feed whose `publish_time` stops advancing *is* the disconnect, and it
is measurable permissionlessly from the Pyth account itself.

types.name: Signal
docs: The latest Pyth-attested market read for one (agent, feed) pair.
Upserted by `record_signal`. It can only exist if a genuine `PriceUpdateV2`
account, owned by the Pyth receiver, carrying the expected feed id, and
inside the caller's staleness policy, was supplied — so the value is an
attestation rather than something the agent merely claims.

fields.name: oracle
docs: The Pyth account this was decoded from.

fields.name: publish_time
docs: `publish_time` from the Pyth account.

fields.name: observed_at
docs: Our clock when we recorded it.

fields.name: amount
docs: Wrapped tokens burned. The user receives less than this — the PreStock
transfer fee applies again on the way out.

types.name: UserStake
docs: Per-holder stake record.

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: `staked_amount * acc_reward_per_share / PRECISION` at last settle.

fields.name: accrued
docs: Rewards settled but not yet withdrawn. Keeping this means `stake`/`unstake`
never silently forfeit accrued rewards.

fields.name: last_stake_slot
docs: Slot of the most recent stake. Anti-flash-loan retention lock.

fields.name: requested
docs: What the user asked to wrap.

fields.name: received
docs: What was actually credited to them (net of the PreStock transfer fee).

fields.name: fee
docs: PreStock transfer fee burned by the mint's Token-2022 `transferFeeConfig`.

types.name: WrapperConfig
docs: Configuration + reserve bookkeeping for one wrapped PreStock.
One `WrapperConfig` exists per PreStock mint (e.g. SPACEX, OPENAI). It owns
both the `wrapped_mint` (mint authority = this PDA) and the `reserve` token
account that holds the raw PreStock backing it.
INVARIANT: `wrapped_mint.supply == reserve.amount`, enforced on every
wrap/unwrap. It can only be broken externally, by PreStocks exercising the
Token-2022 `permanentDelegate` on the PreStock mint — see `bad_debt()`.

fields.name: prestock_mint
docs: The raw PreStock mint (Token-2022, transfer-fee bearing).

fields.name: wrapped_mint
docs: Classic SPL mint, mint authority = this PDA. **This is the DBC quote asset.**

fields.name: reserve
docs: PDA token account holding the raw PreStock.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin allowed to pause and to seed the vault.

fields.name: prestock_decimals
docs: Decimals of the raw PreStock mint (9 for the live PreStocks).

fields.name: wrapped_decimals
docs: Decimals of `wrapped_mint`. Always equal to `prestock_decimals`: the wrapper is
1:1 at the RAW amount level and therefore transparent to `scaledUiAmount`.
(Baking the multiplier in would mis-back every wrapper the moment it changed.)

fields.name: paused
docs: Circuit breaker mirroring PreStocks' `pausableConfig`, which can halt
PreStock transfers out from under us.

fields.name: total_requested_in
docs: Gross PreStock requested in.

fields.name: total_received_in
docs: PreStock actually credited, net of transfer fees.

fields.name: total_fee_paid_in
docs: PreStock transfer fees burned on the way in. Proves we read the extension.
